title: Two lives, two needs
body: Mr Dev lost his job when the factory in his town closed. For months, his family has struggled to pay for food and rent. He spends all his time looking for any daily-wage work and says he has no time to think about anything else. His neighbour, Ms Kaur, is a retired teacher with a secure pension, a close family and much respect in her community. In recent years she has started writing poetry, teaching music to village children for free and learning a new language. She says she wants to become everything she is capable of becoming.

title: Before the board examination
body: Ritika is in Class 12 and her board examinations begin in three weeks. Whenever she opens her chemistry book she feels her stomach churning, her heart races and she cannot concentrate. She has started skipping meals. Her elder brother suggests a plan. First, she should collect the question papers of the last five years, note the frequently asked questions and make a study timetable that leaves ample time for revision. Second, every Sunday she should sit a full mock test at home under timed conditions. Third, whenever she feels very tense, she should lie down in a quiet room for ten minutes, relax her muscles one by one and slow her thoughts, and in the evening she should play badminton for half an hour. After two weeks Ritika says she still feels a little nervous before each mock test, but now she can work through the paper calmly.
